title: Turkish Prawn Revani Sushi Rolls
description: A unique fusion of Japanese sushi and Turkish flavors, featuring pan-seared prawns, crunchy revani crumbs, and a hint of roasted spices.
instructions: Prepare the sushi rice according to the package instructions.
Cut the prawns in half lengthwise and season with sumac, if using.
Pan-sear the prawns in sesame oil until cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Prepare the revani crumbs by crushing them in a food processor or placing them in a plastic bag and crushing with a rolling pin.
Cut the nori sheets into desired sizes for the sushi rolls.
Assemble the sushi rolls with the cooked prawns, cucumber, avocado, and a small amount of sushi rice.
Roll into tight, compact cylinders and slice into individual pieces.
Dust the tops with revani crumbs and serve immediately.
